description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, which extends Android's Fragment. It creates and manages a view hierarchy containing a custom LogView within a ScrollView. The fragment sets up layout parameters, styling, and a text watcher to scroll to the bottom when text changes. It is used as part of an Android app to display log output.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment subclass that displays a log view inside a scrollable container. It initializes views, sets styles, and manages scrolling behavior when log text updates.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, sets styles and layout parameters, and returns the root view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, sets a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on text changes, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used in the fragment.
